title: Scenario
description: A recorded event sequence of one process (model/scenarios/<process stem>/); it belongs to the process.

process.description: The process; the scenario belongs to it.

objects.description: The scenario's cast: the objects its process runs for and the objects they link to. Requires subject.

subject.description: The id of the object the process runs for; required once there are objects.

participants.description: Who acts in the scenario: each stands for an actor, holds roles, groups or organizations (optionally within one of the scenario's objects), and may have an object as its record. A step names the one that acts.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

context.description: Initial context values over the attribute defaults, by attribute id.

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.

at.description: The simulated clock's start (an ISO 8601 instant).

outcome.description: Whether the root is final after the last step.

object.title: Object
object.description: An object of the scenario: an instance of an entity with its values and its links to other objects.

entity.description: The entity the object is an instance of.

values.description: Values by attribute id; a value not given reads as the attribute's default, then null.

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.

states.description: The object's states in lifecycles other than the one the scenario runs, by state id: at most one active configuration per lifecycle, of lifecycles that can govern the object (MQ9305). A compound state enters its default states. A lifecycle not given takes the state the object's bound value maps to, else its initial state.

frozen.description: true: the object starts frozen, so modify and delete are refused, and so are connect and disconnect on its links, until a thaw. Only the subject's freezing is checked; another object's is kept but not read.

links.description: The objects this object links to, each through a relation end.

owner.description: The id of the scenario's participant that owns the object, for a subject whose process entry names no owner field.

link.title: Link
link.description: A link from an object to another object of the scenario through a relation end.

end.description: The id of the relation end navigated from the object.

object.description: The id of the linked object.

frozen.description: true: the link starts frozen, so it cannot be disconnected or have its attributes modified until a thaw; the objects at its ends are not frozen by it. Only on a link of the subject (MQ9305).

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: Someone or something that acts in the scenario.

identity.description: The value the team's system would hold for them, such as a login or a number; the name when absent.

actor.description: The person, external system or system actor they stand for; they then have its memberships.

holds.description: The roles, groups and organizations they hold.

object.description: The id of the scenario object that is their record.

holding.title: Holding
holding.description: A role, group or organization held, with no context or within one of the scenario's objects.

actor.description: The role, group or organization held.

within.description: The id of the scenario object it counts within; without it, it counts only where no context is asked.

step.title: Step
step.description: One input to the process and what is expected after it.

input.description: event, time, invoke-done, invoke-error, or verb: a participant does a verb to the scenario's subject or to one of its links.

after.description: An ISO 8601 duration to advance the clock by, for input time.

verb.description: For input verb: the verb done, an object, link or own verb (MQ9305). Moves, signatures and task completion are event and invoke-done steps.

participant.description: The id of the scenario's participant that acts; the engine works out the actor it acts as unless actor is given.

signer.description: The signing person's identity, for gated events; the participant's identity when absent.

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.

values.description: For a modify verb step on the subject: the values it sets, by attribute id: attributes a set could set, with values of their types (MQ9305). Later guards and sets read them.

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.

attributes.description: For a read verb step on the subject: the ids of the attributes it reads, each checked against the rights that name attributes (MQ9305 beside another verb). Absent, the read is of the object as a whole.

end.description: For a verb step on a link: the id of the subject's relation end the link goes through. Absent, the verb acts on the subject.

object.description: With end: the id of the scenario object at the link's other end, linked to the subject through end except for connect (MQ9305).

assume.description: Results for guards without an expression, by guard id.

expect.description: What is expected after the step.

refusal.description: With accepted false: why the step is refused, the first check that failed (MQ9308).

refusedBy.description: With accepted false: the id of the element that refused the step: the event or invoke whose actors leave the actor out, the right (inline, or the named right), the lifecycle whose default denies, the guard, or the gate or gate policy (MQ9308).

states.description: The active atomic states, in document order.

context.description: The attributes the step changed, by attribute id.

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.

values.description: The object's attributes the step set, by attribute id: exactly the attributes the step changed (MQ9307).

additionalProperties.description: A value of the attribute's type.
